note: The client's claim about itself. Each code appears in exactly one half: the half that mints it — `recognisedFromServer` for codes the edge sends, `mintedByClient` for codes the client derives itself (a bare 400/401 with no JSON body becomes invalid_request / unauthorized; an unparseable response becomes invalid_response). specRevision is the revision of the spec table this claim was last checked against; bumping it is a deliberate act, not a side effect of an edit.
